wolfsbane_nectar.name: Wolfsbane Nectar
wolfsbane_nectar.description: A sealed glass vial containing a potent narcotic extract distilled from purple mountain flowers. Eases mortal agony into painless slumber.

loras_signet.name: Loras's Iron Signet
loras_signet.description: A blackened heavy iron signet ring stamped with the twin dragons of the Iron Drakes. Found amidst the charred ashes of Loras.

turnkey_ledger.name: Turnkey's Stolen Ledger
turnkey_ledger.description: A grease-stained magistrate's ledger detailing clandestine bribes, quarantined contraband, and forged transit manifests.

master_sluice_key.name: Master Sluice Key
master_sluice_key.description: A heavy brass key with three offset teeth, dropped by the deceased quarantine turnkey. Unlocks the outer drainage sluice gate.
master_sluice_key.effect_description: Unlocks the Smuggler's Sluice subterranean drainage gate.

silver_seal.name: Silver Dawnshroud Seal
silver_seal.description: An ornate silver medallion blessed by the High Preceptor, granting Dawnbound chirurgeons unrestricted clearance through quarantine barricades.
silver_seal.effect_description: Grants authorized passage through the fortified Gallow-Gate.

transit_pass.name: Imperial Transit Pass
transit_pass.description: An embossed wax-sealed parchment granting legitimate exit through Oakhaven's fortified Gallow-Gate before midnight.
transit_pass.effect_description: Grants passage through the fortified Gallow-Gate.

vanya_rosary.name: Sister Vanya's Embroidered Rosary
vanya_rosary.description: A silver rosary stitched with sacred prayer threads. Imbued with serene devotion (+2 Lucidity, halves Dread gain; pray to purge 20 Dread).
vanya_rosary.effect_description: Holding the silver rosary in your palms, memories of her passionate warmth flood your mind, driving away the dread (-20 Dread).

silve_favor.name: Silve's Scented Silk Favor
silve_favor.description: A fragrant sheer black lace handkerchief scented with jasmine and rare opium (+2 Guile, 25% sovereign discount; inhale to purge 10 Dread).
silve_favor.effect_description: The intoxicating scent of jasmine, opium, and silk clears your thoughts (-10 Dread).

malakor_whetstone.name: Malakor's Drake Whetstone
malakor_whetstone.description: A blackened oilstone infused with dragon tallow, gifted in sworn brotherhood (+2 Sinew, +4 flat combat damage).
malakor_whetstone.effect_description: You hone your weapon's edge along the oiled stone. Your strikes deal +4 flat damage in combat.
